# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta8

## Added

- Add **Maa- ja Ruumiamet Ortofoto** as an optional map underlay for Estonia.
- Use the official `foto@GMC` Web Mercator TMS layer, so the existing Navimower WGS84 georeference and tile projection can be reused without changing mower map geometry.
- Identify service traffic with `ASUTUS=NAVIMOWER`, `KESKKOND=LIVE` and `IS=NAVIMOWER_MAP_CARD`, which the Maa- ja Ruumiamet MapCache documentation supports as an alternative to a dedicated proxy for service statistics.
- Show the orthophoto option in the Visual Editor only when Home Assistant is configured for Estonia (`country: EE`) or an already loaded Navimower site has been detected inside Estonia.
- Guard orthophoto rendering to Estonia coverage even when the option is configured manually in YAML.
- Support both Single mower and Multi mower views, including transparent Multi mower map backgrounds while an external underlay is active.
- Reuse the existing underlay opacity setting and rename its Visual Editor label to **Map underlay opacity**.
- Show the required **Ortofoto, Maa- ja Ruumiamet** attribution on the map.

## Compatibility

- OpenStreetMap underlay behavior remains unchanged.
- No Navimower integration update, API key, account or additional Home Assistant configuration is required for the Estonian orthophoto layer.
- Existing cards continue to default to no underlay unless the user selects one.
